title: CarbonPlan 3D tavg/prec demo (band axis, no month axis)
description:
The CarbonPlan ndpyramid demo with a band axis and no time axis: `v2/demo/3d/tavg-prec`, 6 levels, each a group holding `<level>/climate` with dims [band, y, x] float32 and chunks `[2, 128, 128]` -- confirmed from `5/climate/.zarray` ([2, 4096, 4096]) and `0/climate/.zarray`. This is the counterpart to carbonplan-4d-climate, which the amplification guard refuses: there the chunk also spans all 12 months, so a tile read wastes 12x, while here the only non-spatial axis is the band axis the renderer reads whole, so the read wastes nothing.

The `band` coordinate is a 2-element `<U4` string array; the band order is taken from the 4D store of the same family, where it was confirmed to be `["tavg", "prec"]` -- estimated here rather than decoded, since zarrita does not read a `<U4` coordinate.

License is unclear for this GCS demo bucket; linked via the CarbonPlan maps project.

Expected browser outcome: draws (viridis ramp on band 1, tavg) at a world view.

band.description: band 0 = tavg, band 1 = prec; order estimated from the 4D store of the same family.

climate.description: Finest level (path "5") is [2, 4096, 4096]; level n is [2, 128 * 2^n, 128 * 2^n].

data.title: CarbonPlan 3D demo climate pyramid (Zarr V2, EPSG:3857)
data.description: ndpyramid "reduce" multiscales, levels "0".."5", each a group holding `climate`, `band`, `x`, `y` and `spatial_ref`.
